The person and escalator form a complete natural scene. A detached horizontal arrow below the escalator indicates direction as a separate modifier.

## Visual draft

A person rides an escalator that slopes upward toward the right, with the upper body visible above its rounded side rail. A separate horizontal right pointing arrow sits below the raised end.

A horizontal line ends in an open right pointing arrowhead with two diagonal arms. Exclude the escalator and rider.
